name: JAGS McCartney International Airport
before:
Grand Turk's airport, a mile south of Cockburn Town, and the second largest in the Turks and Caicos after Providenciales.

It is classed as international but in practice most of what flies here is domestic, chiefly the hop to Providenciales where the international jet services connect. International and charter flights do come in directly during the peak season, and the runway can take aircraft as large as a 757 or an A321.

Plan the ground side carefully. There is no public transport anywhere on the island, so a client needs a hire car or a pre-booked transfer. The airport itself has a restaurant, car hire desks and free parking.

It is named after James Alexander George Smith McCartney, the territory's first Chief Minister, who died in a plane crash in New Jersey in 1980.
after:
Grand Turk's airport, a mile south of Cockburn Town.

It is classed as international but in practice most of what flies here is domestic, chiefly the hop to Providenciales where the international jet services connect.

There is no public transport anywhere on the island, but taxis usually wait outside the terminal and hire cars are collected there too. The airport itself has a small café and restaurant and free parking.

It is named after James Alexander George Smith McCartney, the territory's first Chief Minister, who died in a plane crash in New Jersey in 1980.

claims.why: Wikipedia alone. The operator lists its six public airports without ranking them and publishes no traffic figures by airport; the tourism site's Grand Turk page does not mention the airport. On the operator's own description the airport mostly handles local flights and small planes.

claims.wasBefore: International and charter flights do come in directly during the peak season
claims.why: Wikipedia alone. The operator says the airport typically handles only local flights and small planes, and that all international flights to the islands arrive at Providenciales; its page welcomes private planes but says nothing of seasonal charters.

claims.claim: the runway can take aircraft as large as a 757 or an A321
